CuttingItem.title: CuttingItem
CuttingItem.description: part of of the tool that physically removes the material from the workpiece by shear deformation.

Description.description: free-form description of the cutting item.

itemId.description: manufacturer identifier of this cutting item.

Locus.description: free form description of the location on the cutting tool. For clarity, the words `FLUTE`, `INSERT`, and `CARTRIDGE` **SHOULD** be used to assist in noting the location of a {{block(CuttingItem)}}. {{property(Locus)}} **MAY** be any free form string, but **SHOULD** adhere to the following rules: * The location numbering **SHOULD** start at the furthest {{block(CuttingItem)}} and work it’s way back to the {{block(CuttingItem)}} closest to the gauge line. * Flutes **SHOULD** be identified as such using the word `FLUTE`:. For example: `FLUTE`: 1, `INSERT`: 2 - would indicate the first flute and the second furthest insert from the end of the tool on that flute. * Other designations such as `CARTRIDGE` **MAY** be included, but should be identified using upper case and followed by a colon (:).

CuttingToolLifeCycle.title: CuttingToolLifeCycle
CuttingToolLifeCycle.description: data regarding the application or use of the tool. This data is provided by various pieces of equipment (i.e. machine tool, presetter) and statistical process control applications. Life cycle data will not remain static, but will change periodically when a tool is used or measured.

ConnectionCodeMachineSide.description: identifier for the capability to connect any component of the cutting tool together, except Assembly Items, on the machine side. Code: `CCMS`

ProgramToolGroup.description: tool group this tool is assigned in the part program.

limit.description: end of life limit for the tool.

Location.title: Location
Location.description: location of the pot or spindle the cutting tool currently resides in. If {{property(negativeOverlap)}} or {{property(positiveOverlap)}} is provided, the tool reserves additional locations on either side, otherwise if they are not given, no additional locations are required for this tool. If the pot occupies the first or last location, a rollover to the beginning or the end of the indexable values may occur. For example, if there are 64 pots and the tool is in pot 64 with a {{property(positiveOverlap)}} of 1, the first pot **MAY** be occupied as well.

negativeOverlap.description: number of locations at lower index values from this location.

positiveOverlap.description: number of locations at higher index value from this location.

type.description: type of location being identified. When a `POT` or `STATION` type is used, {{property(value)}} of {{block(Location)}} **MUST** be a numeric value.

toolMagazine.description: tool magazine associated with a tool.

toolBar.description: tool bar associated with a tool.

toolRack.description: tool rack associated with a tool.

automaticToolChanger.description: automatic tool changer associated with a tool.

ReconditionCount.title: ReconditionCount
ReconditionCount.description: number of times the cutter has been reconditioned.

maximumCount.description: maximum number of times the tool may be reconditioned.

ProcessSpindleSpeed.title: ProcessSpindleSpeed
ProcessSpindleSpeed.description: constrained process spindle speed for the tool in revolutions/minute. The {{property(value)}} **MAY** contain the nominal process target spindle speed if available. If {{block(ProcessSpindleSpeed)}} is provided, at least one value of {{property(maximum)}}, {{property(nominal)}}, or {{property(minimum)}} **MUST** be specified.

maximum.description: upper bound for the tool’s target spindle speed.

minimum.description: lower bound for the tools spindle speed.

nominal.description: nominal speed the tool is designed to operate at.

ProcessFeedRate.title: ProcessFeedRate
ProcessFeedRate.description: constrained process feed rate for the tool in mm/s. The {{property(value)}} **MAY** contain the nominal process target feed rate if available. If {{block(ProcessFeedRate)}} is provided, at least one value of {{property(maximum)}}, {{property(nominal)}}, or {{property(minimum)}} **MUST** be specified.

maximum.description: upper bound for the tool’s process target feedrate.

minimum.description: lower bound for the tool's feedrate.

nominal.description: nominal feedrate the tool is designed to operate at.

value.description: status value of the cutting tool.

UpperLimit.description: upper conformance boundary for a variable. > Note: immediate concern or action may be required.

UpperWarning.description: upper boundary indicating increased concern and supervision may be required.

LowerWarning.description: lower boundary indicating increased concern and supervision may be required.

LowerLimit.description: lower conformance boundary for a variable. > Note: immediate concern or action may be required.

SensorId.description: identity of a sensor used to observe some measurement of an item.

Value.description: current interval value of the activity.

NextServiceDate.description: next date/time stamp that maintenance should be performed.

Reset.description: last date/time stamp of the {{term(observation)}} was reset.

Severity.description: level of severity on a scale of 1-10.

LastServiceDate.description: last date/time stamp that maintenance was performed.

Target.description: target value of the next maintenance.

count.description: number of {{termplural(key-value pair)}} represented as {{block(Entry)}} entities.

MeasurementType.description: class of measurement being performed. {{cite(QIF 3:2018 Section 6.3)}} Examples: `POINT`, `RADIUS`, `ANGLE`, `LENGTH`, etc.

MeasurementValue.description: measurement based on the measurement type.

MTConnectAssets.title: MTConnectAssets
MTConnectAssets.description: root entity of an {{term(MTConnectAssets Response Document)}} that contains the {{term(Asset Information Model)}} of {{block(Asset)}} types. ![MTConnectAssets](figures/MTConnectAssets.png "MTConnectAssets"){: width="0.8"} > Note: Additional properties of {{block(MTConnectAssets)}} **MAY** be defined for schema and namespace declaration. See {{sect(Schema and Namespace Declaration Information)}} for an {{term(XML)}} example.

Header.title: Header
Header.description: provides information from an {{term(agent)}} defining version information, storage capacity, and parameters associated with the data management within the {{term(agent)}}.

deviceModelChangeTime.description: timestamp of the last update of the {{block(Device)}} information for any device.

assetBufferSize.description: maximum number of {{block(Asset)}} types that can be stored in the {{term(agent)}} that published the {{term(response document)}}. > Note: The implementer is responsible for allocating the appropriate amount of storage capacity required to accommodate the {{property(assetBufferSize)}}.

assetCount.description: current number of {{block(Asset)}} that are currently stored in the {{term(agent)}} as of the {{property(creationTime)}} that the {{term(agent)}} published the {{term(response document)}}. {{property(assetCount)}} **MUST NOT** be larger than the value reported for {{property(assetBufferSize)}}.

creationTime.description: timestamp that an {{term(agent)}} published the {{term(response document)}}.

instanceId.description: identifier for a specific instantiation of the {{term(buffer)}} associated with the {{term(agent)}} that published the {{term(response document)}}. {{property(instanceId)}} **MUST** be changed to a different unique number each time the {{term(buffer)}} is cleared and a new set of data begins to be collected.

sender.description: identification defining where the {{term(agent)}} that published the {{term(response document)}} is installed or hosted. {{property(sender)}} **MUST** be either an IP Address or Hostname describing where the {{term(agent)}} is installed or the URL of the {{term(agent)}}; e.g., `http://<address>[:port]/`. > Note: The port number need not be specified if it is the default HTTP port 80.

testIndicator.description: indicates whether the {{term(agent)}} that published the {{term(response document)}} is operating in a test mode. If {{property(testIndicator)}} is not specified, the value for {{property(testIndicator)}} **MUST** be interpreted to be `false`.

version.description: {{term(major)}}, {{term(minor)}}, and {{term(revision)}} number of the MTConnect Standard that defines the {{term(semantic data model)}} that represents the content of the {{term(response document)}}. It also includes the revision number of the {{term(schema)}} associated with that specific {{term(semantic data model)}}. As an example, the value reported for {{property(version)}} for a {{term(response document)}} that was structured based on {{term(schema)}} revision 10 associated with Version 1.4.0 of the MTConnect Standard would be: 1.4.0.10

AssetCount.title: AssetCount
AssetCount.description: count of each asset type currently in the {{term(agent)}}.

Error.title: Error
Error.description: error encountered by an {{term(agent)}} when responding to a {{term(request)}}.

errorCode.description: descriptive code that indicates the type of error that was encountered by an {{term(agent)}}.

value.description: textual description of the error and any additional information an {{term(agent)}} is capable of providing regarding a specific error.

Agent.title: Agent
Agent.description: {{term(agent)}}. An {{term(agent)}} **MUST** perform the following tasks: * Collect data from manufacturing equipment. * Generate {{termplural(response document)}}. * Provide a REST interface using {{term(HTTP)}}. In addition to {{term(XML)}} and {{term(HTTP)}}, An {{term(agent)}} **MAY** provide additional protocols and representations. Some representations **MAY** have companion specifications.

instanceId.description: identifier for an {{term(instance)}} of the {{term(agent)}}. {{property(instanceId)}} **MUST** be changed to a different unique number each time the {{term(buffer)}} is cleared and a new set of data begins to be collected.

bufferSize.description: maximum number of {{termplural(Observation)}} that **MAY** be retained in the {{term(agent)}} that published the {{term(response document)}} at any point in time.

maxAssets.description: maximum number of {{termplural(Asset)}} that **MAY** be retained in the {{term(agent)}} that published the {{term(response document)}} at any point in time.

assetCount.description: current number of {{termplural(Asset)}} that are currently stored in the {{term(agent)}} as of the {{property(creationTime)}} that the {{term(agent)}} published the {{term(response document)}}.

AssetCountDataSet.title: AssetCountDataSet
AssetCountDataSet.description: count of each asset type currently in the {{term(agent)}}.
